name: Perl
about: Perl 5.42.3, at the paths the base up-term.lha used to carry
copy_comment: ; Perl 5.42.3 (bin/perl (a static build with no module tree)): the same
; paths in UP-Term: the base put them at (bin, share, licenses; vsh finds the program on its path).
welcome: It goes into UP-Term:bin and UP-Term:share,
why: Copying Perl to UP-Term:bin and UP-Term:share.
readme_contents: bin/perl (a static build with no module tree).
readme_use:
; these files were part of it before the
slim base. It installs them at the same paths in UP-Term: (bin, share, licenses): no new drawer, no
change of the path. In an UP-Term window, in vsh:
  perl -v
licenses_notes:
These files were part of up-term.lha until the slim base (P9); the package installs them at the
  same paths in UP-Term:. Its row of SOURCES.txt is in UP-Term:licenses/perl/SOURCES.txt.

The complete source with UP-Term's patches and build recipes is up-term-src.lha, published next to
  up-term.lha.
